preconditions.description: The number of employees, including Allen, is between 1 and 3000.
The maximum salary is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= p_i <= i for all i in range(2, n+1)
preconditions.description: Each employee's direct superior is a valid employee number.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of ways to assign salaries modulo 10^9 + 7.

invariants.expression: no employee can make strictly more than his superior
